title: speeeecies locale manifest v0.1
description: One place the live simulation can show, contributed as `locales/<id>/locale.json`. A locale names a public centroid (never a street address or a private yard), its climate, a generic plot template, and at least 8 species that already exist under `species/` (aim for 12 or more). A locale may also ship `locales/<id>/flora-catalog.json`, the plants its garden shows; without one the simulation uses a biome default catalog. `flora_wishlist` holds names only, for local plants no drawable taxon resembles. Unknown keys are rejected.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

id.description: Lowercase slug, equal to the directory name: a place then a country hint, e.g. `london-uk`.

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. `A London garden`. Name a city or district, never a street.

activity_region.description: ISO 3166-2 (or 3166-1) code whose monthly activity curve every listed species must carry in `activity.regions[].region`. Must be `country` or a subdivision of it.

public_lat.description: Latitude of a public centroid (a city, district or park), in degrees, with at most 2 decimals (about 1 km). The validator rejects more precision.

public_lon.description: Longitude of a public centroid, in degrees, with at most 2 decimals.

koppen.description: Köppen-Geiger climate class at the centroid. Picks the simulation's biome default flora when the locale has no `flora-catalog.json`.

elevation_m.description: Elevation of the centroid in metres above sea level.

place_source.description: Where `public_lat`, `public_lon`, `elevation_m` and `koppen` come from: a public page for the city or district (Wikidata and Wikipedia are fine). Optional but recommended; reviewers check the centroid against it.

attribution.description: Required by the validator for anything that is not CC0 or public domain.

plot_template.description: Generic plot the simulation builds the scene from. No real footprints or geometry are contributed.

species.description: Slugs of species under `species/<slug>/`, at least 8 (aim for 12 or more). Each must carry an activity curve for `activity_region`.

flora_wishlist.description: Plants you would like to see here, by name only (scientific or common), especially ones no taxon in `flora-catalog.json` can stand in for. These names are not validated or imported; ship `locales/<id>/flora-catalog.json` for plants the garden actually shows.

blurb.description: One or two sentences shown when the locale is on screen.

facts.description: Short facts the simulation may show or narrate. Each carries its source and licence.

attribution.description: Required by the validator for anything that is not CC0 or public domain.

contributors.description: Who wrote the manifest, credited publicly when the locale goes live. Optional; git history is the authority.

agent.description: The coding agent used, if any (e.g. `claude-code`).
